title: gilibertia juergensenii
intro: Gilibertia juergensenii, commonly known as Mexican Valerian, is a plant species in the Caprifoliaceae family. It is a perennial herb used for its medicinal and therapeutic properties. The health benefits of Gilibertia juergensenii include its sedative and anxiolytic effects, which can help alleviate stress, insomnia, and anxiety. The bioactive constituents of this plant include valepotriates, valepin, and other volatile compounds, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as inducing sleep and reducing muscle spasms.
